subject: LaunchWeek cohort: trial extension & promotional credits request
messages:
From: LaunchWeek Accelerator <ops@launchweek.vc>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex@nova.build>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Request: cohort trial extension + promo credits for Nova.build

Hi Sergio,

Hope you're well — LaunchWeek cohort kickoff next month and a few of our founders (including Alex at Nova.build) are evaluating Redwood for their product demos. Nova.build is still in closed alpha but they will need a higher API allowance for the 6-week demo period.

Quick ask: would Redwood consider a 90-day trial extension and a $10k promotional credit for Nova.build tied to the LaunchWeek cohort? The goal is to: 
- Give them enough runway to build a public demo
- Surface latency/perf data for the cohort report we publish

Attached an intake form with the runway and usage estimate. If helpful, we can do a short mutual action plan and an onboarding call next week.

Thanks — appreciate you taking a look.

Best,
Alex Chen
Founder, Nova.build
alex@nova.build
LaunchWeek Accelerator (ops@launchweek.vc)

Attachment: launchweek_intake_form.xlsx (spreadsheet with usage estimates)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@nova.build>, LaunchWeek Accelerator <ops@launchweek.vc>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: cohort trial extension + promo credits for Nova.build

Hi Alex — thanks for the note and the intake.

Short answer: we can often support cohort exceptions, but I need a quick internal OK on the credit and a signoff on the onboarding timeline. To move fast, can you confirm three things in one reply:
1) Expected peak concurrent tokens per minute during demo windows
2) Whether any demo data will include customer PII (we need to know for Private/Hosted decision)
3) Primary point of contact for onboarding (name + email)

I'll loop in Ben and Marissa to expedite approval. If you prefer, we can schedule a 20-min call tomorrow.

On our side I'll start a short approval thread and draft a simple MOU for the credit.

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Partnerships, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com

Sergio / Marissa — reviewed the intake and usage estimate. Quick summary:
- Stage fit: pre-seed / alpha — qualifies for cohort promo
- Risk: no PII called out in intake (confirm before provisioning)
- Ask: $10k promo credit over 90 days + priority onboarding slot

I approve the promotional credit on a one-off basis, conditional on:
1) Nova.build confirms no PII in demo artifacts
2) MOU signed by their founder (we'll keep it lightweight: credit amount, term, basic usage limits)
3) Engineering will reserve a small burst pool; ops to monitor usage and surface regressions

I'll attach the approved credit summary and the MOU template. Legal can run a quick review of the MOU; procurement isn't required for this amount.

Ben Carter
Head, Growth Programs, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

2) MOU & signature: I've attached the MOU template Ben referenced. I'll send a DocuSign envelope this afternoon for a quick sign.
3) Provisioning & kickoff: we can provision the credit and schedule a 30-minute onboarding call next Tuesday (Jul 3) at 10:00am PT. Please let me know if that works and who will join.
